source: Google Teachable Machine (image project, Keras export)
architecture: MobileNetV2 feature extractor (width 0.35, ImageNet weights) + Dense(100) + Dense(softmax), the standard Teachable Machine export
note: No held-out accuracy has been recorded for this model yet. Measure it with `python evaluate_model.py --data_dir <labelled photos>` or retrain with train_model.py, which records accuracy, macro F1 and per-class scores.
